Author: Maciej Kosiedowski
Message:
Add the Laravel integration for slimad/indexnow

A dedicated Laravel package around the framework-agnostic core: queue URLs as
your content changes, submit them in batches from the scheduler or a queue
worker, and never talk to a search engine during a web request.

Service container

* IndexNowServiceProvider with package auto-discovery, a publishable
  config/indexnow.php and a publishable migration. Every seam is a singleton, so
  the pending queue cannot silently split in two.
* The IndexNow facade over IndexNowManager: submit(), submitMany(), pending(),
  clear(), flush() and dispatchFlush().
* The submit job is resolved lazily, so queueing a URL keeps working on an
  application that installed the package but has not configured it yet.

Storage

* CacheUrlStore keeps the queue in one cache entry and takes a cache lock around
  every mutation when the store supports one, so concurrent requests do not
  overwrite each other.
* DatabaseUrlStore survives cache flushes and deploys. URLs are deduplicated on
  a SHA-256 hash rather than on the URL column, because MySQL caps a unique index
  at 3072 bytes.
* Both stores skip unreadable rows instead of throwing, so one bad entry cannot
  block the queue forever.

Submission

* LaravelHttpIndexNowClient submits through Laravel's HTTP client, so timeouts,
  retries and Http::fake() behave the way the rest of the application expects.
  Rejections surface as the core SubmitFailedException, not a Laravel one.
* SubmitQueuedUrlsJob is unique, so a slow submission cannot overlap with the
  next scheduled run and submit the same batch twice.
* Optional scheduler binding for indexnow:flush, with withoutOverlapping().

Developer experience

* Artisan: indexnow:flush, indexnow:submit, indexnow:status, indexnow:key.
* SubmitsToIndexNow trait plus a ProvidesIndexNowUrls contract for Eloquent
  models; return an empty iterable to skip drafts.
* Optional /{key}.txt route so no static file has to be dropped into public/.
* UrlsQueued, SubmissionCompleted and SubmissionFailed events.
* Every setting is readable from an environment variable and tolerates the
  string shapes env() produces.

Quality gates

192 tests, 100% line coverage enforced in CI, a 97.8% mutation score against a
95% floor, Larastan level 8 with no baseline and Laravel Pint. The matrix covers
PHP 8.2-8.4 against Laravel 11, 12 and 13, plus a lowest-dependency run.
composer audit runs weekly and Dependabot watches Composer and the workflows.
